Why Study in Canada?

Country-specific advantages for academic and career progression

Up to 3-Year PGWP

Graduates of 2-year programs qualify for 3-year open Post-Graduation Work Permits to gain valuable Canadian work experience.

Global Degree Recognition

Degrees from Canadian universities and polytechnics are celebrated globally for quality and research excellence.

Welcoming & Diverse Society

Canada is consistently ranked among the safest and most student-friendly nations in the world.

Co-op Work Terms

Paid co-op internships integrated into your curriculum allow you to earn money while building professional Canadian networks.

Education Pathway for Bangladeshi Students

Step-by-step qualification progression for SSC, HSC, Diploma, and Bachelor graduates

Pathway 1

SSC / O-Level

High School Completion / Foundation Program

Complete high school prerequisites or pre-university foundation in Canada.

Pathway 2

HSC / A-Level

2-Year College Diploma or 4-Year Bachelor Degree

Direct entry to colleges and universities with HSC GPA 3.5+ or 2 A-Level passes.

Pathway 3

Diploma (4-Year BTEB)

Advanced Diploma or Bachelor with Credit Transfer

Polytechnic diploma holders can transfer credits into 2nd/3rd year of Canadian Bachelor programs.

Pathway 4

Bachelor Degree (4 Years)

1-2 Year Post-Graduate Certificate (PGC) or Master's

Specialized Master's or Post-Graduate certificates with minimum CGPA 2.8+ from Bangladesh.

* Final eligibility depends on university, course, academic profile, English score, study gap and other admission requirements.

Canada Student Visa Process

Official step-by-step roadmap from university offer to visa stamp

1

Apply to DLI & Receive Letter of Acceptance (LOA)

Secure admission at a designated learning institution.

2

Obtain Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL)

Receive the official PAL issued by the provincial government.

3

Purchase Guaranteed Investment Certificate (GIC)

Deposit $20,635 CAD in an approved Canadian financial institution.

4

Pay First-Year Tuition Deposit

Pay 1 full year of tuition to your college/university.

5

Complete Upfront Medical Exam

Undergo immigration medical exam at an approved panel physician in Dhaka.

6

Submit IRCC Visa Application & Biometrics

Submit application online and provide biometrics at VFS Canada Visa Application Centre.

Frequently Asked Questions

Country-specific answers verified by ALO Education compliance

What is a Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL)?

A PAL is a mandatory provincial verification document required alongside your Letter of Acceptance (LOA) for Canadian study permit applications.

How much is the Canadian cost of living requirement (GIC)?

The IRCC financial threshold is $20,635 CAD for a single applicant, typically purchased as a Guaranteed Investment Certificate (GIC).

How long is the Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP)?

Graduates of 2-year programs receive a 3-year PGWP. Programs between 8 months and 2 years receive a PGWP matching course length.

What is a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)?

A DLI is a Canadian school approved by a provincial or territorial government to host international students.

Can I study in Canada without IELTS?

Most Canadian universities and colleges require IELTS Academic, PTE Academic, or TOEFL iBT for direct admission.

Can polytechnic diploma holders apply to Canada?

Yes, 4-year BTEB diploma graduates can apply for Post-Graduate Certificates or Advanced Diplomas with credit transfers.

How long does Canadian study permit processing take in Bangladesh?

Processing generally takes 7 to 12 weeks depending on seasonal application volumes at IRCC.

Can my spouse work while I study in Canada?

Spouses of students enrolled in Master's and Doctoral degree programs can apply for an open work permit.

What is a Co-op work permit?

A Co-op permit allows students to complete mandatory paid internships required by their academic curriculum.

What are the main intake seasons in Canada?

Fall (September), Winter (January), and Summer (May).

What is the minimum GPA required for Canadian Master's?

Most Canadian universities require a minimum CGPA of 3.0 out of 4.0 in a 4-year Bachelor's degree.

What documents are required for Canadian Study Permit?

Valid passport, LOA, PAL, GIC certificate, 1-year tuition receipt, SOP, academic transcripts, and upfront medical report.

Is an upfront medical examination required?

Yes, Bangladeshi applicants must complete a medical exam at an IRCC-approved panel physician in Dhaka before submitting.

Can I transfer credits from Bangladesh to a Canadian university?

Yes, universities evaluate course syllabi and mark sheets individually to grant transfer credits.

What is the difference between College and University in Canada?

Colleges focus on hands-on practical diplomas and certificates, while Universities offer academic Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degrees.

How much is tuition fee in Canada for international students?

Colleges range from $15,000 to $20,000 CAD/year; universities range from $20,000 to $35,000 CAD/year.

Can I apply with a study gap in Canada?

Yes, study gaps supported by valid employment certificates, tax documents, and salary proofs are accepted.

Where do I give biometrics for Canada in Bangladesh?

At the VFS Canada Visa Application Centre located in Delta Life Tower, Gulshan-2, Dhaka.

What is a Letter of Explanation / SOP for Canada?

A detailed statement explaining your academic background, choice of Canadian program, financial capability, and career plans in Bangladesh.

Does ALO Education assist with PAL and GIC setup?

Yes, ALO Education guides you step-by-step through LOA issuance, PAL collection, GIC bank account opening, and visa file preparation.
